name: practitioner-probe
description: Converts an ambiguous codebase concern, issue, or plausible-but-shallow implementation into a decision-changing technical probe. Applies when mechanism, affected actor, evidence, or instruction yield remains unclear.

contract.what: A small set of technical questions that distinguishes consequential possibilities.
when: Code appears plausible but shallow, a gap lacks mechanism, or an issue lacks decision-changing evidence.
boundaries: A direct, already-scoped repair proceeds through its owning workflow. Scores, levels, and probabilities appear only when they change a decision. Any level or veracity label describes one artifact claim, evidence state, or repair path; it does not credential a practitioner, rank an AI system, or certify the probe itself.
contract.result: Mechanism, observable evidence, gap utility, instruction yield, transfer boundary, and receiving route.

receivingUse.job: Code appears plausible but shallow, a gap lacks mechanism, or an issue lacks decision-changing evidence.
receivingUse.materialResult: Mechanism, observable evidence, gap utility, instruction yield, transfer boundary, and receiving route.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
